To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) literacy knowledge is distributed through shifts in participant role; (2) literacy knowledge is available through the participation framework; and (3) the participation framework is a tool that mediates the distribution of literacy.
the distribution of literacy is accomplished through the social construction of the participation framework in writing activity.
the distribution of literacy is a social phenomenon and that it is mediated by talk and the participation framework.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how talk and participation in purposeful writing activities mediate the distribution of literacy knowledges among novice writers.
the social distribution of knowledge in literacy activities, and how the participation framework mediates this distribution.
the social distribution of knowledge through talk in writing activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
talk matters in the distribution of knowledge in the classroom, and in particular, the talk of teachers and students is a key factor in distributing literacy knowledge among novice learners.
the participation framework of a literacy activity mediates the distribution of literacy knowledges among participants in a writing activity.
the distribution of literacy is not only a social activity, but that talk is a critical component of this distribution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the distribution of literacy practices is mediated by the role of the teacher as pivot in the participation framework of journal writing activity.
talk and participation matter in writing activity.
the distribution of literacy is mediated by the participation framework, and the role of pivot is a central mechanism in that mediation.
